basic_info.description: Rare Ingleside 3BD/2BA Opportunity With Character, Bonus Space and Room To Make It Your Own! Classic 1940s Mid-Century Modern SFR in Ingleside/Merced Heights offers a valuable opp for buyers seeking a vintage prop w/solid fundamentals & flexibility to update. Much of the original character remains - plus bonus living space - making this a strong starting point for renovation, restoration, or thoughtful reimagining. Main level features a flexible layout incling a formal LR, eat-in kitchen, 2BDs incl a primary suite, full 2nd BA, and a home office or 3rd guest BR. Direct access from the primary suite to a small patio deck & terraced yard creates a rare private indoor-outdoor connection. Lower level offers bonus rooms ideal for a media room, family room, or creative use, plus a 1-car garage & storage. Prime location near Ocean Ave & Stonestown Galleria for shopping/dining. EZ access to Balboa Park BART, MUNI lines, and I-280 for commuters. Close to Merced Heights Playground, Brooks Park, SFSU, & CCSF. 250 Monticello St is ideal for buyers ready to invest in a home w/ character, space, & long-term potential in a convenient SF neighborhood.
